title: feat(spec,lint): flows translation face gains approvals.NODE.label for an approval node's step label
body:
Closes #24915

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

`TranslationDataSchema.flows.FLOW` carried `label`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage`, `screens.NODE` (screen nodes) and `refusals.NODE` (refusing `end` nodes), and nothing for an `approval` node. A language pack had nowhere to put an approval step's name. HotCRM measured this: `flows.opportunity_approval.screens.manager_review.title` is refused `translation-target-unknown`, because `manager_review` is an `approval` node and not a screen.

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`): `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE.label` is a declared key. It is addressed by the `approval` node's `FlowNode.id` and overlays that node's own `label`. The entry is closed (`strictObject`). `title`, `name`, `heading` and `stepLabel` are renames onto `label`, and `approval` on the flow level is a rename onto `approvals`.
- **`objectstack validate`** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`): the translation-reference check collects the flow's `approval` node ids at any depth, using the same `walkFlowNodes` universe, so regions are included. An `approvals.NODE` key over an approval node resolves. Over anything else it is refused `translation-target-unknown`, with the existing diagnosis style:
  - a node of another type: "...declares as a `decision` node, not an `approval`, so nothing resolves this key."
  - a `screen` node: "...declares as a `screen` node; its heading is keyed `screens.NODE.title`."
  - an unknown id: "...declares no node for, so the step keeps its source-locale label.", followed by "Did you mean" over the approval nodes.
- **Wrong-group guidance**: a `screens.NODE` or `refusals.NODE` key written over an approval node now says "...declares as an `approval` node; its step label is keyed `approvals.NODE.label`." The old message only said the node is not a screen. It also read "as a `approval` node".

## Why this spelling

- **Group `approvals`, keyed by node id**: this follows the grammar the face already has. `screens` addresses `screen` nodes and `refusals` addresses refusing `end` nodes, each by `FlowNode.id`, the identifier the approvals service already holds (`sys_approval_request` stores it as `flow_node_id`).
- **Leaf `label`, nothing else.** I read `ApprovalNodeConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts`). Its keys are `approvers`, `behavior`, `minApprovals`, `lockRecord`, `approvalStatusField`, `onEmptyApprovers`, `fallbackApprovers`, `decisionOutputs`, `escalation` and `maxRevisions`. None of them is a heading, instructions text or a comment prompt. The one person-facing string an approval step carries is `FlowNode.label`. `plugin-approvals` copies that label onto `current_step_label` when a request opens (`approval-service.ts`, `labelOrMachineName(input.nodeLabel, ...)`). A screen spells its leaf `title` because it overlays `ScreenConfigSchema.title`. This leaf overlays the node label, so it is spelled `label`, and `title` is an alias onto it.
- **Plain string, not a `{{ }}` text slot**: the node label is plain text that is copied, not rendered through `renderTextSlot`. This is the same as the flow's own `label`.
- **Out of scope, on purpose**: a typed `decisionOutputs[]` entry's `label` (a field label in the decision dialog). It stays an `owed` row in the family pin, with its reason updated. It is a separate surface that needs its own reader.

## Tests

Measured at head `606faa06ee` (merged with `origin/main`).

- Repro first: commit `ebb460a714` added the tests before the fix.
- **Reverse verification**: after the fix was committed, I restored `translation.zod.ts` and `validate-translation-references.ts` to the base `81e6edd463` (tree only, `git restore --source`). The mutation was confirmed on disk (`approvals: z.record` count 0, `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE` count 0). I rebuilt spec and ran the suites:
  - spec: `6 failed | 158 passed`. The four new approvals cases failed, and so did the two face-pin cases ("every keyed row ... exists in the face", "every face key is filled").
  - lint: `6 failed | 180 passed`. The five new refusal/redirect cases failed, and so did the one-line-verdict arm coverage.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATHS`. `git diff HEAD` was empty and `git status` was clean. I rebuilt spec, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker present in 20 built files.
- **Controls**:
  - screen and refusal keys of the same flow still resolve beside an approval key;
  - a `screens` key over a `decision` node keeps its own diagnosis;
  - an approval key on a non-approval node is refused by name;
  - a key the approval entry does not declare (`instructions`) is refused at parse.
- **Family pin** (`flows-translation-face.test.ts`): `node.label` is now `keyed` to both `screens.NODE.title` and `approvals.NODE.label` (new `also` field), so the face-key-filled check accounts for the new key.
- **Package runs**:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 703 files, 21365 passed.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 151 files, 7002 passed (after the merge).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: OK.
- **Generated artifacts and data checks**:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts are up to date. These were regenerated with `--fix`: `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, the strictness-ledger counts and the liveness state counts.
  - `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, and `check:nul-bytes`: OK.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`): 113 derived, 113 run, all `exit 0`, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every family recorded an exit code), re-run on the merged head `606faa06ee`.
- **eslint, narrowed to the 5 touched source and test files** (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. All 5 are inside the config (`--print-config` resolves each). The config declares no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.

## Liveness

`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json` gains a `flows.approvals` row (drilled to `label`) with status `planned`, not `live`. The reader that renders the step label in the reader's locale is the `plugin-approvals` half of #24863, which this PR does not touch. It is a contract-first split, the same way `screens` and the toasts landed. #24863 remains open.

## Review tier

`packages/spec` is a published schema, so this PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before it enters the queue (pm-dispatch `references/contract-review.md`). It touches no governed surface (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, workflows, `skills/**`), so no Tier S or Tier H landing rule applies.

## Acceptance notes

- The CLI i18n extractor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) does not emit `approvals.NODE.label` slots in a skeleton. Asking apps to translate a key with no reader would be a declared-but-not-honoured demand. That demand belongs with the reader in #24863. `check:i18n-walk-parity` is green with this diff.
- The flow-level alias `steps: 'screens'` is left as it is. An author who writes `steps` for an approval step is told it renames to `screens`, and validate then points them at `approvals`.
- No `flowApprovalLabelKey` resolver helper is added. With no reader it would be an export with no consumer. The reader card can add it next to `flowRefusalMessageKey`.
